# Junk Brawlers LLC

> Owner-operated junk removal serving North Georgia, founded and run by Tony Frias out of Dawsonville, GA. Same-day service 7 days a week, 5.0 stars across 60+ Google reviews. Volume-based pricing — you pay for the space your items fill in the truck — with a free on-site estimate before any work begins, starting at $150.

## Services

- [Junk Removal](https://junkbrawlers.com/junk-removal.html): Furniture, appliances, and general clutter hauled away, often same-day.
- [Estate Cleanouts](https://junkbrawlers.com/estate-cleanouts.html): Full-property cleanouts for estates, downsizing, and transitions.
- [Garage Cleanouts](https://junkbrawlers.com/garage-cleanouts.html): Clear out a packed garage in a single visit.
- [Hot Tub Removal](https://junkbrawlers.com/hot-tub-removal.html): Disassembly and haul-away of hot tubs and spas.
- [Appliance Removal](https://junkbrawlers.com/appliance-removal.html): Refrigerators, washers, dryers, water heaters, and more.
- [Construction Debris Removal](https://junkbrawlers.com/construction-debris-removal.html): Post-renovation and jobsite debris.
- [Commercial Junk Removal](https://junkbrawlers.com/commercial-junk-removal.html): Offices, retail, rentals, and commercial properties.
- [Hoarder Cleanouts](https://junkbrawlers.com/hoarder-cleanouts.html): Compassionate, discreet full-property cleanouts.
- [Shed & Deck Removal](https://junkbrawlers.com/shed-deck-removal.html): Demolition and removal of old sheds and decks.
- [Pool Removal](https://junkbrawlers.com/pool-removal.html): Above-ground pool teardown and haul-away.
